# libxposed service (vendored)

Unmodified Java sources of `io.github.libxposed:service:102.0.0` and
`io.github.libxposed:interface:102.0.0` (AIDL-generated Java from the published
sources jars, Maven Central). Upstream: https://github.com/libxposed/service

Licensed under the Apache License 2.0 — see `LICENSE`.

Vendored as sources (compiled by `build.sh` with `--release 17`) because the
prebuilt `classes.jar` trips an internal error in build-tools 34 d8.
